Engines are the inference servers llm-helper can launch, such as vLLM or llama.cpp.
Each is a definition: how it is installed, its command line, how it takes the model
and the API key, and how its health is read. They ship in the binary, and files in
<config>/engines.d can add more without a rebuild. A profile picks one with PROVIDER,
and a recipe with its provider field.

## Usage

```console
llm-helper engines
```
